Fill monthly gaps by the unit's own monthly climatology

Source: R/agroclimate.R
fill_monthly_gaps.Rd

Missing values are replaced by the mean of the same calendar month in the same unit (station or cell). The positions that were filled are returned in the `filled` attribute so they can be reported.

Usage

fill_monthly_gaps(x, month)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector (one unit) or matrix with units in rows and months in columns.

month

Integer month of each column (or element).

Value

Object of the same shape as `x`, with attribute `filled` (logical, same shape) and `n_filled` (per unit).

Examples

x <- c(10, 20, NA, 40, 12, 22, 30, 42)
f <- fill_monthly_gaps(x, month = rep(1:4, 2))
f
#> [1] 10 20 30 40 12 22 30 42
#> attr(,"filled")
#> [1] FALSE FALSE  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
#> attr(,"n_filled")
#> [1] 1
attr(f, "filled")
#> [1] FALSE FALSE  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
